extraction.Name: Emma Black Feather, nee Garnier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent to her 160 acre allotment at the time she got it; but she was told that, if she did not accept it, it would be assessed for the taxes, and finally sold for same, so she took it
extraction.Buyer: George Linhan, of Oglala, South Dakota; he paid her $400.00 in cash, gave her the privilege of buying $400.00 worth more in merchandise, taking over her place for $1200.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: she was owing a store bill of $400.00, in 1920, to George Linhan, of Oglala, South Dakota, and that she gave him a mortgage on her land to cover this debt; that, in 1921, being unable to pay this mortgage off, he paid her $400.00 in cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: a little lease money coming in; husband supports the family by farming the land of one of his daughters, and works for neighbors on the farm as common laborer
extraction.NOTES: Mentally incompetent, has poor health, was wounded once and has had rheumatism ever since; has six children to support, four of whom have good health and two are sickly; husband has poor health; she considers that the price she got for her place was poor; has never received any help from the County, State or the United States Government; document number No. 30 34; subscribed and sworn December 1, 1928 | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 48 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal. | Split-digit fix: NOTES read 'document number No. 30 34' (stray space between digits in source); regex captured '30' but actual allotment is 3034. Confirmed by user review. | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Oglala (Pine Ridge Agency)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
